name: multi-rigid-body
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学

complete_examples.text: In this study, a train consists of several multi-rigid-body vehicles, and the track is modeled by various finite elements.
The train includes several identical vehicles regarded as multi-rigid-body systems.
In this work, a three-dimensional and coupled model for multi-rigid-body of train and finite elements of track and substructures is presented by multi-scale assemble and matrix reassemble method.
Each vehicle is modeled as a multi-rigid-body system, which consists of one car body, two bogie frames and four wheelsets with two-stage suspensions.
